name: No Live Trading
specification: Submitting live orders, routing orders, or interacting with broker exchange endpoints.

name: No Broker Integration
specification: Authenticating or connecting with broker accounts, APIs, or trading gateways.

name: No Real Orders
specification: Generating real orders or trade tickets for execution.

name: No Investment Advice
specification: Presenting regime states, transitions, or scores as financial or trading advice.

name: No Signal Interpretation
specification: Treating regime taxonomy, matrices, candidates, or validation acceptance as trade signals.

name: No Directional Claims
specification: Claiming bull/bear certainty, target prices, or directional buy/sell superiority.

name: No Strategy / Backtest / Optimizer
specification: Simulating strategies, calculating PnL, running backtests, or parameter optimization.

name: No Model Training / Fitting / Prediction
specification: Executing model fit, train loops, or forward prediction generation.

name: No Clustering Execution
specification: Running unsupervised k-means, GMM, or clustering algorithms (schema prep only).

name: No Target / Label Generation
specification: Creating supervised target returns, directional labels, or forward classes.

name: No Sentiment Model Outputs
specification: Running NLP sentiment models or deriving subjective sentiment polarity scores.

name: No Full Article / Scraped HTML
specification: Downloading, storing, or processing full article text, raw content, or scraped web HTML.

name: No Embeddings / Vector Databases
specification: Creating vector embeddings or connecting vector search databases.

name: No Production / Broker Approval Claims
specification: Claiming that acceptance reports constitute production-ready or broker-approved certification.

name: No Source Overwrite / Destructive Actions
specification: Modifying, overwriting, deleting, or truncating raw source files.

name: No Auto-Imputation / Auto-Drop
specification: Silently imputing missing values or automatically dropping columns.

name: No Web Scraping
specification: Executing real-time HTTP scraping or crawling news/financial websites.

name: No Credential Leaks
specification: Exposing, printing, or recording API keys, secrets, tokens, or credentials.

name: No Cloud Deployment
specification: Pushing containers, deploying cloud functions, or creating remote resources.

name: Local & Offline Governance
specification: Running acceptance reporting, gate audits, and inventory verification locally without network access.

name: Inventory & Dependency Validation
specification: Ensuring all required phase modules (126-135) and sequential dependency graphs are formally verified.

name: Script, Test, & Docs Contracts
specification: Confirming existence and contract compliance of runner scripts, test suites, and documentation.

name: Non-Signal & No-Lookahead Compliance
specification: Verifying that all regime matrices, candidates, and catalogs strictly enforce backward-asof joins and zero signals.

name: Metadata-Only News Ingestion
specification: Validating that economic calendar and news context rely strictly on timestamps, titles, and release metadata.

name: Source Preservation
specification: Guaranteeing zero modifications to underlying raw lake datasets.

name: FeatureStore Metadata Readiness
specification: Providing standardized namespaces, schemas, and catalog access for research query contracts.

name: Phase 136 ML/GPU Handoff
specification: Preparing clean architectural foundations and prerequisite checklists for Phase 136 GPU acceleration.
